content.text: Next I'll build a per-edge comparison across both periods, using the server-side callee to name each peer. That will show which edges slowed beyond what their callees explain.

input.query: WITH n AS (SELECT 'n' pd, * FROM normal_traces), a AS (SELECT 'a' pd, * FROM abnormal_traces), al AS (SELECT * FROM n UNION ALL SELECT * FROM a), e AS (SELECT c.pd, c.service_name caller, s.service_name callee, c.duration cd, s.duration sd, c.attr_status_code cs FROM al c JOIN al s ON s.pd=c.pd AND s.trace_id=c.trace_id AND s.parent_span_id=c.span_id WHERE c.attr_span_kind='Client' AND s.attr_span_kind='Server') SELECT caller, callee, sum(CASE WHEN pd='n' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_n, sum(CASE WHEN pd='a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_a, round(avg(CASE WHEN pd='n' THEN cd END)/1e6,1) c_n, round(avg(CASE WHEN pd='a' THEN cd END)/1e6,1) c_a, round(avg(CASE WHEN pd='n' THEN sd END)/1e6,1) s_n, round(avg(CASE WHEN pd='a' THEN sd END)/1e6,1) s_a, sum(CASE WHEN pd='a' AND cs='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) err_a FROM e GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY c_a DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT p, metric, attr_source, attr_destination, count(*) n, round(avg(value),2) avg_v, round(max(value),2) max_v FROM (SELECT 'n' p, * FROM normal_metrics_sum UNION ALL SELECT 'a', * FROM abnormal_metrics_sum) WHERE metric IN ('hubble_tcp_flags_total','hubble_drop_total') AND attr_source LIKE '%travel-plan%' AND attr_destination LIKE '%seat%' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,1

content.text: TCP-flag counts on the travel-plan → seat connection roughly doubled (48 → 107 average, max 417). To decide between a network fault and an HTTP-layer fault, I'll compare pod-level network I/O and errors for travel-plan and seat across periods, plus the reverse-direction flags.

input.query: SELECT 'n' p, metric, service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*) n, round(avg(value),2) avg_v, round(max(value),2) max_v FROM normal_metrics_sum WHERE metric IN ('k8s.pod.network.errors','k8s.pod.network.io') AND (service_name LIKE '%travel-plan%' OR service_name LIKE '%seat%') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', metric, service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*), round(avg(value),2), round(max(value),2) FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric IN ('k8s.pod.network.errors','k8s.pod.network.io') AND (service_name LIKE '%travel-plan%' OR service_name LIKE '%seat%') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,3,1
